call_points.text: FY27 wire rope volume growth guided at 10-12%, including the Middle East at current levels.
Value growth guided at ~15% for FY27, with volume growth continuing at similar levels in coming years.
India Ratings upgraded long-term rating to IND AA- from IND A+ with stable outlook.
Operating margin floor raised to a minimum of 20%, from the earlier 18-19% band.
Order book not quantified; management says visibility for the next six months and 85% of business is replacement market.
Analyst pressed on why margins would fall from 22% to 20%; management said 22% is not a straight-line benchmark.
Plasticated LRPC approvals expected in weeks; current output 2,500 tons, targeted to double to 4,000-4,500 tons.
Thailand plant modernisation to show significant improvement over the next 18 months, adding specialised cords and elevator ropes.

operating_notes.text: FY26 revenue grew 6.2% to ₹3,691.1 Cr with operating EBITDA at ₹705.1 Cr.
Rope capacity is about 140,000 tons at 75% utilisation; wires 80,000 tons at 75-78%; LRPC about 60,000 tons plus 6,000 tons plasticated at about 70%.
LPG and propane costs rose to ₹120,000-130,000 per ton from ₹60,000, adding ₹2.5-3 Cr a month, with 25% of requirement shifting to natural gas.
International revenue is 57% of topline; Europe about 26% and the US 9%, with US market share below 5%.
Value-added rope share rose to 73% of the wire rope business in Q1FY27 from 70% in FY26, supporting EBITDA per tonne of ₹40,581.
Realisation per tonne in Q1FY27: wires ~₹85,000, blended LRPC ~₹79,000, domestic rope ~₹1,90,000 and international rope ~₹3,70,000-3,80,000.
Middle East is ~9% of revenue; India holds 65-70% rope market share, 60-65% in elevator ropes and over 95% in ports.

On 8 May 2026, Usha Martin filed the transcript of its Q4 & FY26 earnings call, where management guided to a minimum 20% operating margin and 10-12% volume growth, with ₹300 Cr capex over two years.
Rajeev Jhawar, as Promoter, confirmed no encumbrance on Usha Martin shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) on April 7, 2026.
Q1FY27 (Jul 2026): Revenue rose 16% YoY to ₹1,033 Cr, EBITDA margin 20.1%, PAT ₹142 Cr; India Ratings upgraded to IND AA-; net cash ~₹465 Cr.
